bananaman_43046: In Old Harrow, Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman was a fisherman. In S-F17, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a fisherman again.
A flare lit the Ossuary Wood like noon. Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.

Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman of the Hegemony threw a tin of tobacco into the Concord trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Wendel "Mole" Day kept the tin. Mail came up the line with a letter for Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman. Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Now serving as a chaplain, Lucien "Shadow" Bananaman discovered that being experienced at the front did not prevent being new at the job.
spring_7398: "You're late," said the corporal when Yann Spring arrived on Day 3. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Yann Spring helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
The dugout roof dripped into Yann Spring's mug. He moved the mug. The roof found another way.
Tobias "Crow" Cowboii and Yann Spring carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
